answer: Every sparrow holds one sponsorship for life: it stakes its whole shale behind a single newcomer, who locks m times that stake as its own bond and must clear judged work within one horizon — miss it and both bonds burn. Slots never refill, so an operator's clones chain down generations: the second locks m² base, the third m³ base, and a hollow link burns its own bond plus every sponsor's shale above it. A chain of k fakes therefore locks base×m^(k−1) and spends k sponsors; a newcomer outside any chain locks base.
